# Southern Biological

> Southern Biological is an Australia-based supplier of anatomical models, educational anatomy kits, and scientific teaching materials for medical and educational institutions.

The site specializes in high-quality anatomical models from leading manufacturers like 3B Scientific and Bone Clones, serving anatomy education, medical training, and anthropology programs. Their product range spans human skeletal systems, organ models, and specialized educational genetics and health consequence displays.

## Key Topics

- Anatomical models
- Human skeleton
- Skull models
- Educational anatomy
- 3B Scientific

## Skeletal & Anatomical Systems

- [Human Skeleton Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/human-skeleton-models): Disarticulated and articulated human skeleton models for anatomy teaching
- [Human Skull Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/human-skull-models): Wide range of human skull models from 3B Scientific and Bone Clones
- [Animal Skull Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/animal-skull-models): Animal skull models including primate, mammal, and museum-quality specimens
- [Anthropology](https://www.southernbiological.com/anthropology): Anthropology products featuring primate skulls and hominid specimen replicas
- [Head Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/head): Head models featuring skull, musculature, and anatomical structures

## Organ & Body System Models

- [Human Torso Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/human-torso-models): Dissectable dual-sex human torso models for comprehensive anatomy education
- [Heart Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/heart): Heart anatomy models at 2x life-size for classroom and lecture hall education
- [Brain Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/brain): Brain anatomy models with removable parts for educational classroom display
- [Digestive System Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/digestive-system): Digestive system models including liver, pancreas, and organ representations
- [Eye Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/eye-models): Eye models demonstrating optical functions for human anatomy teaching
- [Ear Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/ear-models): Ear anatomy and ossicle models for auditory system education

## Specialized Anatomy Models

- [Human Pelvic Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/human-pelvic-models): Female and male pelvis models for reproductive anatomy education
- [Hand and Arm Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/hand-and-arm): Hand and arm anatomy models including carpal tunnel and osteoarthritis variants
- [Feet and Lower Limb Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/feet-and-lower-limb): Foot and lower limb models showing bones, muscles, ligaments, and nerves
- [Dental Models](https://www.southernbiological.com/anatomy-models/dental-models): Dental education models for teeth, jaw, and dental anatomy training
